section_1.label: Section 1
section_1.description: Which Bloomberg section to pull headlines from first.

section_3.label: Section 3
section_3.description: Optional third section, added after Section 2. Ignored unless Section 2 is also set.

custom_url.label: Custom feed URL
custom_url.description: Optional. Any RSS feed URL. Overrides all Section slots when set.

transition.label: Transition
transition.description: How headlines change in 'one at a time' mode.

refresh.label: Refresh interval
refresh.description: How often to fetch new headlines from Bloomberg.

tz.label: Time zone
tz.description: Zone for the timestamp, if 'Show timestamp' is on.
